residualDefinition: The largest |r|/sqrt(n) over the coupled solver's convergence criteria at each coupling iteration, r the change of the coupled interface data; residual is the last iteration. Physical units are undeclared.
residualUnavailableReason: Weak coupling exchanges the interface data once per step and evaluates no convergence criterion.
